subject: RFP: Marketplace listing governance, billing and invoice flow (RFP-2026-317)
messages:
From: Daniel Reiss <daniel.reiss@bigcorp.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bigcorp.com
Date: 2026-10-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: RFP - Marketplace listing governance, billing & invoice flow

Sofia —

Thanks for taking a look at RFP-2026-317. The procurement team at BigCorp Analytics is consolidating requirements for marketplace listings across AWS/Azure/GCP. We need clarification and evidence for the following sections so we can move to the final evaluation: 

- Governance & listing controls: degree of tenant isolation, marketplace listing lifecycle, who can push updates.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II, encryption at-rest/in-transit, key management details.
- Auditability: retention of audit logs, ability to produce per-tenant access logs, export formats.
- Billing & invoice flow: how purchases routed through each marketplace are invoiced, sample invoice, metering vs one-time purchases, billing reconciliation expectations.

Please provide the documents (SOC 2, architecture diagram, billing flow diagram, sample invoice) and any brief notes about differences across AWS/Azure/GCP. Our deadline for vendor addendum is Oct 20 — can you confirm if you can provide materials and a short 30-min call next week?

RFP reference: RFP-2026-317
Thanks,
Daniel Reiss
Senior Procurement Manager
BigCorp Analytics

--
Attachment stubs requested: SOC2 report, architecture diagram, billing flow, sample invoice

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP - Marketplace listing governance, billing & invoice flow

Adding billing/finance details (summary):

- AWS Marketplace: For AMI/Container listings we support both SaaS and metered subscriptions. Customers buying via AWS Marketplace may receive consolidated AWS invoices; Redwood issues reconciliation reports (CSV) and monthly invoices to the marketplace reseller where required. For metered purchases, usage files are generated daily and reconciled monthly.
- Azure Marketplace: Purchase route is through Microsoft; billing typically flows on the customer's Microsoft invoice. We provide SKU-level usage reports and a sample invoice template to aid reconciliation.
- GCP Marketplace: Often handled via partner/reseller paths; depending on listing type Redwood may invoice directly or via a reseller agreement. We'll provide example invoice and mapping guidance.

Attached (stubs): marketplace-billing-matrix.xlsx (matrix of flows, sample IDs), invoice-sample-redwood.pdf (example Redwood invoice with line-item mapping).

Open questions for Daniel (should confirm on call):
- Do you need vendor-level invoices to appear on your ledger or is Microsoft/AWS consolidated invoice sufficient?
- Metering frequency tolerance (some teams want daily, some monthly aggregates).

ETA: I'll prepare the billing matrix + invoice sample for Sofia to send external by EOD 10/14.

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
